typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DateStamp as string (),
	DeltaDate as timestamp (),
	ExportFile as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	FTPFile as string (),
	FTPFolder as string (),
	OverrideBeginDate as timestamp (),
	OverrideEndDate as timestamp (),
	QueryBeginDate as timestamp (),
	QueryEndDate as timestamp (),
	TimeStamp as string (),
	UpdateDeltaDateInd as integer ()
}

source(output(
		SERVCIE_END_DATE as string,
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_NPI as string,
		RENDERING_PROVIDER_ID as string,
		BILLING_PROVIDER_NPI as string,
		RENDERING_PROVIDER_NPI as string,
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_ID as string,
		BILLING_PROVIDER_ID as string,
		SERVICE_START_DATE as string,
		MEMBER_PCP_NPI as string,
		BILLING_LOCATOR_CD as string,
		MEDICAID_NUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT 	RTRIM(H.B_ALT_ID) AS [MEDICAID_NUMBER], 	RTRIM(H.BLNG_PRV_ID) AS BILLING_PROVIDER_ID, 	RTRIM(H.[BLNG_NPI_NUM]) AS BILLING_PROVIDER_NPI, 	RTRIM(H.[PCP_NPI_NUM]) AS MEMBER_PCP_NPI, 	RTRIM(H.[SVCF_PRV_ID]) as SERVICING_PROVIDER_ID, 	RTRIM(H.[SVCF_NPI_NUM]) AS SERVICING_PROVIDER_NPI, 	\'\' AS RENDERING_PROVIDER_ID, 	RTRIM(H.RNDR_NPI_NUM) AS [RENDERING_PROVIDER_NPI], 	RTRIM(L.LI_BEG_DOS_DT) AS SERVICE_START_DATE, 	RTRIM(L.LI_END_DOS_DT) AS SERVCIE_END_DATE, RTRIM(H.BLNG_LOCATOR_CD) AS BILLING_LOCATOR_CD	 FROM [ODW].[DW].[VLM_NC_ClaimHistory_Header] H 	INNER JOIN [ODW].[DW].[VLM_NC_ClaimHistory_Line] L ON H.TCN_NUM1 = L.TCN_NUM 		AND CONVERT(DATE,H.LASTUPDATEDATETIME) = CONVERT(DATE,L.LASTUPDATEDATETIME) where H.[FileName]  LIKE \'NCT_BCBS_CL_MEDHDR_%.DAT\' AND L.[FileName]  LIKE \'NCT_BCBS_CL_MEDLINE_%.DAT\' AND H.LASTUPDATEDATETIME > ? AND H.LASTUPDATEDATETIME <= ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		SERVICE_END_DATE as string,
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_NPI as string,
		RENDERING_PROVIDER_ID as string,
		BILLING_PROVIDER_NPI as string,
		RENDERING_PROVIDER_NPI as string,
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_ID as string,
		BILLING_PROVIDER_ID as string,
		SERVICE_START_DATE as string,
		MEMBER_PCP_NPI as string,
		BILLING_LOCATOR_CD as string,
		MEDICAID_NUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		SERVICE_END_DATE = SERVCIE_END_DATE,
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_NPI,
		RENDERING_PROVIDER_ID,
		BILLING_PROVIDER_NPI,
		RENDERING_PROVIDER_NPI,
		SERVICING_PROVIDER_ID,
		BILLING_PROVIDER_ID,
		SERVICE_START_DATE,
		MEMBER_PCP_NPI,
		BILLING_LOCATOR_CD,
		MEDICAID_NUMBER)) ~> FlatFileDestination
